answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150968 Country: India Title: It is right name Kaleelullah or kalilullah for my new born baby? Please advice I want to set a good name of my new born son. Is it good or advice new name baby born on 15-04-2017. My name is Khizar Hussain. Question: It is right name Kaleelullah or kalilullah for my new born baby? Please advice I want to set a good name of my new born son. Is it good or advice new name baby born on 15-04-2017. My name is Khizar Hussain. Answer ID: 150968 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 967/863/SN=8/1438) Khalilullah means Allah’s friend. It was the surname of Hadhrat Ibrahim (may Allah have mercy upon him) and Kalimullah means the one who talks Allah, it was the surname of Hadhrat Musa (may Allah have mercy upon him), both the names are correct. You may choose any one for your bhatija. (2) It should be noted that according to Islamic teaching it is important that the name has suitable meaning. It is not important to look the date and month the child was born as it is the practice of others. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
